tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bstod sgrub maṇḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga dngos grub lhun grub bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ārya tā ra ye/ gang gi dang por byang chub thugs bskyed nas/ /gang zhig gdul bya thabs kyis 'dul ba'i phyir/ /gang gi phrin las lha mor nyer bstan ma/ /gang yang 'khor ba las sgrol ma la 'dud/ /gang la brten nas gnas skabs mthar thug gi /gang 'dod dngos grub myur du sgrub pa'i thabs/ /gang de'i rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi/ /gang gsungs cho ga'i gsal byed 'bri bar bya/ /de la 'dir rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bstod bsgrub maṇḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga 'di la dus phyis tshogs gsog pa kun dga' tshul khrims dang / mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis sogs kyis yig cha re mdzad 'dug kyang / rtsa ba'i yi ge rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab dang cung zad mthun min byung bas/ 'dir rje btsun mchog gi gsung rab la chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i yig cha gsal byed du bkod nas/ de la dogs gzhi byung ba rnams gsed bkrol dang sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi lag len bde bar 'dri na/ de yang rje btsun mchog gi gsung rab las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ maṇḍal bzhi pa'i gsol 'debs la gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ dus dang / gnas dang / rten dang / mchod pa bshams pa'o/ /dus ni bsod nams gsog pa yin na/ tshes brgyad dam/ nya stong lta bu la bya/ bar chad sel na/ rims dang / 'dre gdon dang / chom rkun dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / rmi lam ngan pa la sogs bar chad byung ba'i dus su bya/ 'dod pa sgrub na nangs par lta bu don gang bsgrub pa'i dus te/ de dag ni dus so/ /gnas ni gtsug lag khang ngam/ mchod khang la sogs nyams dga' bar bya'o/ /gsum pa rten ni bla ma yi dam spyi dang /

dkon mchog spyi'i lugs ma'am/ ras bris la sogs pa ci rigs pa dgram/ rje btsun ma'i lugs sku'am/ ras bris gang rung gcig bzhugs su gzhug go /mchod pa'i steng du bla re rnga yab la sogs pa ci rigs pas brgyan/ maṇḍal ni re kha zlum po khor yug gnyis pa bzhi bri'o/ /yang na shing ngam 'khar ba'i maṇḍal bzhi/ gcig las med na bskyal la dbul/ me tog bzhi/ mar me bzhi/ lha bshos bzhi/ yon chab dang / dri chab dang / mchod pa rnams bzhi bzhi bshams/ med na ci rigs par bshams mo/ /me tog ni zangs gzhong la sogs par bsdog gsol 'debs tsa na 'thor zhing bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de'i lag len ni tshes brgyad la sogs pa'i dus de dag tu sku gsung thugs rten mang du bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang ngam/ yang na rang gi gnas khang byi dor byas la/ gnam sa bar gsum gyi rgyan ci 'byor dgram/ rje btsun ma'i sku sogs rten ci 'byor bzhugs pa'i drung du stegs bang rim lnga pa ras gtsang ma sogs kyis bkab pa la 'bru bkram par chu gcig sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga tshar bzhi dang / bang rim 'og mar zlum gtor bzhi dang / de rnams kyi drung maṇḍal tshom bu so bdun ma'am bdun ma tshar bzhi bshams/ bsdu na mchod gtor maṇḍal rnams tshar gcig gis chog rang nyid rten la kha phyogs pa'i drung stegs kyi khar rdor dril me tog gam/ ting shags gang rung bshams pa ni sbyor ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya ba dang / dkon mchog spyi la gsol ba gdab pa dang / rje btsun ma la gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi zhes pa nas/ 'grub par shog gi bar gsum brjod la don yid la bya'o/ /gnyis pa dkon mchog spyi la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dang po bla ma la phyag bya/ de nas yi dam la/ de nas sangs rgyas la/ de nas byang sems la/ mchod pa dang maṇḍal dang po phul/ yan lag bdun pa rgyas bsdus gang rung gcig byas la 'dod pa'i don gang bsgrub pa de la gsol ba gdab bo/

/zhes gsungs pa la/ chos rje bla mas/ dang po ni/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas mchod pa bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang oṃ las rin po che'i snod du so so'i ming gi dang po'i yi ge las rdzas so sor bskyed/ so so'i sngags rgyas byin gyis brlab/ badzra ghaṇḍe ra ṇi dang rol mos byin dbab/ zhes gsungs pas bsdu na chos rje'i gzhung 'dis chog spro na mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ las mchod yon/ paṃ las me tog dhaṃ las bdug spos/ daṃ las mar me/ gaṃ las dri chab/ naṃ las zhal zas/ shaṃ las rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ aḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du shapta'i bar la'ang sbyar la/ mthar ghaṇḍe ra ṇi ta rol chen dang bcas par bya/ rje btsun gyis skyabs sems sangs rgyas chos tshogs mas chog par mdzad pa ni bsdus pa'i lugs yin la/ chos rjes skyabs 'gro'i rjes la sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma dang / tshad med bzhi bya bar gsungs pa rgyas pa'i lugs yin pas/ de'i tshul ni/ skyabs yul mkha' khyab la bdag dang sems can rnams skyabs su 'gro bar bsam nas/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes gsum bdun nyer gcig sogs brjod/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis bsnyen sgrub bgyis pa 'di dag gis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/lan gsum/ zhes sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces pas tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ chos rjes 'od zer 'phros nas spyan 'dren par ma gsung yang / rmor chen gyi gsung rab na 'od zer 'phros nas tshogs zhing spyan 'dren par gsungs pa ni skabs su babs shing 'brel chags pas/ de'i tshul ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi nas/ yongs dag 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal/ chos srung gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa mngon sum lta bur byon nas mdun du rin po che'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur zhes brjod/ tshig lhug 'di ni chos rje'i gsung las kho bos cung zad rgyas su btang bar 'gal ba med de/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i phyag 'tshal gyi tshig dang mthun pas so/ /de ltar spyan drangs nas phyag 'tshal gyi skabs rje btsun gyis bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems la phyag 'tshal bar gsungs/ chos rjes nor lha'i rjes la nyan thos dang / bla ma kha shas la phyag 'tshal mdzad 'dug kyang / 'dir rje btsun gyi gsung dang mthun pa'i phyag 'tshal rgyas pa ni/ rten rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / ngag tu/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i sku ni rdo rje'i sku/ /mdzes shing lta bas chog mi shes/ /bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan ldan/ /bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs/

/'gag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan/ /mu stegs log lta 'joms mdzad pa/ /bla ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i thugs ni nam mkha' 'dra/ /bde gsal mi rtog ngang tshul ldan/ /rnam thar gsum la legs gnas pa'i/ /bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /kun gyi mdzad po bla ma yin/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas rtsa ba'i bla ma la phyag bya/ mdo rgyud man ngag rig gnas bcas/ /thub bstan ji bzhin gsal mdzad pa'i/ /'dzam gling mkhas grub thams cad la/ /rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang phyogs mun pa'i smag rum tu/ /rgyal bstan nyi 'od gsal mdzad pa'i/ /gang ljongs bstan 'dzin thams cad la/ /rtse gcig dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i rgyal srid la/ /dbang bsgyur rje btsun sa skya pa/ /yab sras bu slob mkhas grub la/ /bka' drin rjes dran phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brgyud pa'i bla ma spyi bye brag dang / de gras chos rje'i gsung rab nas byung ba ni/ 'dzam bu gling du bstan pa'i srog shing btsugs/ /kha ba can du chos kyi sgron me sbar/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa shākya'i sras kyi gtso/ /mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang don yal bar dor nas gzhan gyi don/ /lhur mdzad de ni gangs can 'gro ba'i dpal/ /dngos sam brgyud pas gzhan gyi don mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan a ti sha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa chen 'di na ngo mtshar rnam mang yang / /rgya gar kha che rgya nag bal bod li/ /yul gang na yang mtshungs med chos kyi rje/ /'dzam gling sgron me khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / /gdul bya sna tshogs 'dul ba'i phyir/ /khro chags sgeg dang zhi ba'i sku/ /grub gnyis stsol mdzad rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes yi dam spyi phyag dang / mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing /

/de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pas 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las sgrol zhing / /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa'i/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing / /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ /skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che/ /'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che/ /bla med dkon mchog gsum la༞ /chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la༞ /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob/ /'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srungs dang / /shākya thub pa gau taṃ lha yi lha/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun la༞ /bskal pa grangs med 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /phongs gyur 'gro ba mtha' dag bskyab pa'i phyir/ /smon lam khyad par can rnams btab gyur pa'i/ /bde bar gshegs pa brgyad la༞ /phyogs bcu'i 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas/ /phyogs bcur chos kyi 'khor lo legs bskor bas/ /phyogs bcu'i 'gro kun yongs su skyobs mdzad pa'i/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la༞ /sngon gyi smon lam byang chub rjes spyad pas/ /mtshan tsam thos pas sgrib pa kun sel ba/ /phrin las mnga' ba kun mkhyen 'jig rten mgon/ /sangs rgyas sum cu lnga la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthun pa'i smon lam dge tshogs rmad byung zhing / /spyad pa spyod tshe na yang mchod gyur la/ /bskal bzang gcig la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje sogs dang༞ rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba/ /ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra/ /grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lham me ba/ /mgon po mchog gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/

/mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal/ /gser mdog 'dra ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum ma mchis/ /mnyam med mkhyen chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gcig ma lus rkang gnyis gtso/ /dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /gser gyi mdog can lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /dam tshig gsum bkod rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rjes kun la snyoms pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel/ /dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ /baiḍūrya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs dang / skur gyur pa ni thams cad la/ /mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis mnga' zhing / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags ldan pa/ /rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzogs sangs gang du bltams pa dang / /gang du byang chub la reg dang / /zhi ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /zag med mya ngan 'das phyag 'tshal/ /bde gshegs gang du bzhugs pa dang / 'chags pa dang ni bzhengs pa dang / /seng ge lta bur gzims pa yi/ /gnas de la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang / /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su yang / /skur bcas sku ni med pa yi/ /mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /smra bsam brjod med sogs dang / rgyal ba'i bstan pa mkha' ltar yangs pa'i lam/ /don dam dmigs med spros pa kun las 'das/ /dbyangs kyi mtshan tsam kun mkhyen ngo bo nyid/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs las skyes pa'i sras/ /byang chub spyod pa bla med mthar phyin pas/ /shākya'i rgyal po'i rgyal tshab mchog gyur pa/ /mgon po mi pham pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rga shi'i 'jigs spangs gzhon nur gyur pa ste/ /gzhan don dgyes pas 'dzum pa'i zhal ras can/ /sna tshogs sprul mdzad 'od zer mtha' yas pa/ /bcom ldan 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje gcig bsdus pa/

/spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi rje/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus dpyis 'byin pa/ /thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtse ba'i thugs rje'i dbang phyug nyid kyi sku/ /drang srong chen po'i tshul du bstan nas kyang / /'gro ba'i gdung ba drag po sel mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba nyid kyang thugs rje'i dbang gis na/ /lha mo'i tshul ston kun nas gsal pa'i sku/ /yid bzhin nor bu padma legs bsnams pa/ /shes rab pha rol phyin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku/ /'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs/ /nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal/ /gzi brjid 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i dbang phyug 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /don yod zhags pa khro rgyal rta mgrin dpal/ /ral gcig ma dang lha mo khro gnyer can/ /'phags pa lha lnga'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs/ /sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel/ /nam mkha'i snying po byams pa kun tu bzang / /nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha dang klu dbang grub pas cod pan gyis/ /rin chen 'od zer 'phro bas gang gi zhabs/ /kun tu gsal bas nyi ma'ang zil gnon pa/ /phongs pa kun skyob sgrol ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /brtse ba'i rjes chags pad ma rā ga'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis mdzes pa'i sku/ /mda' gzhu utpal dbang gi lcags kyu 'dzin/ /bcom ldan rigs byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba 'jigs pas nyen pa bskyab pa'i phyir/ /brtse bas 'jigs byed khro mo'i skur bstan nas/ /dbugs 'byin mdzad cing dngos grub mchog stsol ba/ /sgrol ma drag mos 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku/ /ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma/

/rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mar gad mdog mtshungs nyi ma lta bur gsal/ /nyon mongs dug 'joms rma bya'i mjug sgro dang / /dngos grub kun stsol bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin/ /rma bya chen mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang / /bar du gcod pa kun las grol 'gyur zhing / /dri med bde ba chen po thob mdzad pa/ /lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin ind+ra nī la'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs zung brjid pa'i sku/ /ye shes ral gri rdo rje'i zhags pa bsnams/ /khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal chen ston ka'i mdog gi mdangs ldan zhing / /dus mtha'i sprin ltar hūm̐ gi 'brug stong chem/ /'bar ba'i rdo rjes bgegs kyi glad 'gems pa/ /phyag na rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma lus rgyal ba'i gnyis med ye shes las/ /nye bar bsgrub pa'i mthu stobs rdo rje yis/ /bgegs kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par 'joms byed pa/ /dpal chen rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rjes gdug pa 'dul phyir rab khros pa/ /byi ru'i mdog mtshungs pad ma'i dbyug to 'dzin/ /rta mchog zhal gyi sgra yis bdud 'joms pa/ /khro rgyal rta mgrin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab rgya mtsho yi/ /rnam par 'phrul pa'i dpal las legs byung zhing / /sgrub pa po la blo gros mchog ster ba/ /lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'byung lnga'i mdog can 'byung chen lnga la dbang / /kun tu bsgyur byed rdo rje'i 'dab gshog can/ /klu yi dpal 'phrog lha mi'i dpal gyur pa/ /rdo rje nam mkha' lding la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la sems kyi dam pa rin chen de/ /skyes pa de'i sku la phyag 'tshal zhing / /gang la gnod pa byas kyang bder 'brel ba/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi/ /dgra bcom blo mchog dbang po kun dul ba/

/bstan pa'i srid du legs par brtan bzhugs nas/ /bstan pa 'dzin dang bsrung dang skyong mdzad pa/ /'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug bzhugs pa ni/ /gnas brtan bha ra dhā dza bsod snyoms len/ /'phags pa gser can ba ku la dang ni/ /gnas brtan lam brtan rdo rje mo yi bu/ /'phags pa sbed byed sgra gcan 'dzin dang ni/ /klu yi sde dang gnas brtan yan lag 'byung / /nags na gnas dang dgra bcom ma pham pa/ /lam phran brtan dang gser phreng mi phyed pa/ /dus ldan bzang po zhes bya la phyag 'tshal/ /zab mo'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis legs bsgoms pas/ /rang byung rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni/ /gtan pa med pa'i tshul gyis thugs chud pa/ /'phags pa rang rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal/ /nye bar thob nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs bsrung ba'i/ /rdo rje chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas/ /tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes nas/ /sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa/ /nor sbyin rnams la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' ltar khyab pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /lus 'di zhing rdul mnyam par rab sprul nas/ /rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas phyag bya/ spyi phyag 'di ni chos rje'i gsungs la nged rang nas cung zad rgyas su btang ba yin kyang / rje btsun chos rje gnyis kyi dgongs pa dang mi 'gal ba ni dpyod ldan dag gis rtogs nus shing / bsdu na sangs rgyas sogs bla ma la shlau lo ka gcig dang / mgon po thugs rje sogs dkon mchog spyi phyag shlau ka gsum/ phyag byar 'os pa sogs shlau ka gcig gis 'thus so/ /rje btsun gyis/ dkon mchog spyi'i skabs su phyag mchod maṇḍal yan lag bdun pa rnams las bstod pa ma gsungs/ chos rjes mchod pa yan lag bdun par bsdus nas bstod pa dkon mchog rjes dran gsungs kyang /

'dir gnyis ka'i dgongs pa ltar bgyis na rgyas pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur bas/ de nas gong du byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams las/ tshar dang po de la dmigs te/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla re dang / /mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab rgyas shing / /mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po skyabs gnas thams cad mchod/ /oṃ gu ru traṃ ratna maṇḍal la sa pa ri wā re arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du me tog nas/ rol mo'i bar la 'don pa bsgyur/ sngags thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ arghaṃ gyi gnas su puṣpe sogs mchod pa so so'i sngags bcug shapta'i tshe rol mo bya'o/ /de nas maṇḍal dang po de tshom grangs mang nyung dang bstun 'bul tshig so bdun ma'am bdun ma gang rung gis phul/ gang ltar kyang ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes pa dang / bzhes nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sgrib sbyong tshogs rdzogs bsam don 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sngags gong 'og 'dra ba las arghaṃ sogs kyi gnas su maṇḍal bcug bsdu na sa gzhi spos byugs ma sngags tsam bcas kyis chog dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dran pas/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de ni bsod nams dag gi rgyu mthun pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams chud mi za ba/ bzod pas brgyan pa/

bsod nams kyi gter rnams kyi gzhi/ dpe byad bzang po rnams kyis spras pa/ mtshan rnams kyi me tog rgyas pa/ spyod yul ran par mthun pa/ mthong na mi mthun pa med pa/ dad pas mos pa rnams la mngon par dga' ba/ shes rab zil gyis mi non pa/ stobs rnams la brdzi ba med pa/ sems can thams cad kyi ston pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yab/ 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams kyi rgyal po/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du 'gro ba rnams kyi ded dpon/ ye shes dpag tu med pa/ spobs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gsung rnam par dag pa/ dbyangs snyan pa/ sku byad blta bas mchog mi shes pa/ sku mtshungs pa med pa/ 'dod pa dag gis ma gos pa/ gzugs dag gis nye bar ma gos pa/ gzugs med pa dag dang ma 'dres pa/ sdug bsngal dag las rnam par grol ba/ phung po dag las rab tu rnam par grol ba/ khams rnams dang mi ldan pa/ skye mched rnams bsdams pa/ mdud pa rnams shin tu bcad pa/ yongs su gdung ba dag las rnam par grol ba/ srid pa las yongs su grol ba/ chu bo las brgal ba/ ye shes yongs su rdzogs pa/ 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi ye shes la gnas pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa la mi gnas pa/ yang dag pa nyid kyi mtha' la gnas pa/ sems can thams cad la gzigs pa'i sa la bzhugs pa ste/ 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sku che ba'i yon tan yang dag pa rnams so/ /dam pa'i chos ni/ thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos legs par gsungs pa/ yang dag par mthong ba/ nad med pa/ dus chad pa med pa/ nye bar ston pa/ 'di mthong ba la don yod pa/ mkhas pa rnams kyis so sor rang gi rig par bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la legs par bstan pa/

nges par 'byung ba/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'gro bar byed pa/ mi mthun pa med cing 'dus pa dang ldan pa/ rten pa yod pa/ rgyu ba bcad pa'o/ /theg pa chen po'i dge 'dun ni legs par zhugs pa/ rig par zhugs pa/ drang por zhugs pa/ mthun par zhugs pa/ thal mo sbyar ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ phyag bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ bsod nams kyi dpal gyi zhing / yon yongs su sbyong ba chen po/ sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa/ kun tu yang sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa chen po'o/ /zhes brjod/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nas/ byang chub phyir bsngo'i bar yan lag bdun pa bya/ yan lag bdun pa'i skabs su/ ji snyed nas bstod bar la phyag bya/ me tog dam pa sogs nas mchod par bgyi la rol mo byas la/ phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi bar brjod/ rol mo bzhag nas tsog pur 'dug la 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs nas/ phyir bsngo'i bar bya'o/ /bsdu na ston pa bla med sogs shlau ka gcig dang / phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa sogs shlau ka gcig gis chog gang ltar yang / de nas maṇḍal la sogs pa yod na dbul/ med na me tog thogs/ thal mo sbyar/ skabs su 'thor zhing / phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa/ bla ma bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa/ da ltar bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams sku khams bzang zhing sku tshe ring ba/ rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas pa/ sems can rnams bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs shing byang chub kyi sems gnyis rgyud la skyes nas 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims la gnas te don gnyis phun tshogs 'grub pa'i skal ba dang ldan par 'jig rten du char chu dus su 'bebs shing lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa/

nad dang 'khrugs pa mu ge med cing bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa/ khyad par sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi nad gdon bar chad zhi/ tshe dang bsod nams 'phel/ dpal dang 'byor pa rgyas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pas gsol ba gdab bo/ /yang rje btsun gyis/ gsum pa rje btsun ma la gsol ba gdab pa la gsum ste/ dang po mdun gyi rje btsun ma'i rten bshams pa de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ po ta la nas ye shes pa spyan drangs nas de la gnyis su med par bstim mo/ /yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rje btsun ma'i rnam par spyan drangs la thams cad gnyis su med par bstim mo/ /de nas dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi ngo bor mos la/ zhes gsungs pa la chos rjes/ gnyis pa la/ maṇḍal gsum 'bul ba'i dang po ni/ mdun na rje btsun ma'i rten yod na bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las tāṃ yig ljang khu las gyur pa'i rje btsun ma ljang khu/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon utpal la'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar bzung nas snyan gyi thad kar kha phye ba/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang / g.yon bskum zla ba'i rgyab yol/ 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can du bskyed pa'am/ rten med na po tā las sgrol ma 'khor bcas spyan drangs par bsams la/ tāṃ yig ljang khu las 'khrungs shing / /'od dpag med kyis dbu la brgyan/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas 'phrin las ma/ /'gro ba'i don phyir gshegs su gsol/ /zhes brjod/ zhes gsungs pa/ bsdu na bskyed chog 'di bzhin dang / spro na mdun gyi rten bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tāṃ yig ljang khu las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/

sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las kyi ngo bo rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog margad kyi lhun po la nyi ma shar ba ltar rab tu dwangs shing 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gnyis dang ldan ma/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon utpa la'i yu ba thugs kar mtheb srin gyis bzung nas 'dab ma snying gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ spyan dkyus ring ba'i spyan gnyis sems dpa'i lta stangs kyis 'gro ba mtha' dag thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shing / zhal 'dzum zhing rab tu zhi ba/ dbu skra mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud spyi bor bcings pa'i rtser 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can lhag ma cung zad thur du 'phyang ba/ nu 'bur zung gis mdzes shing lang tsho dar la babs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs gsol ba/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan snyan rgyan mgul rgyan dpung rgyan phyag gdub sor gdub/ zhabs gdub sku rags/ se mo dos mdzes par brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa/ shin tu mdzes shing lta bas chog mi shes pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i skur gyur/ de'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i tāṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ lho phyogs po tā la nas rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥ bsdu rgya se gol rdor dril g.yab gsil lam/ ting shags dkrol zhing gdangs yod med gang rung gis/ gong gi spyan 'dren gyi tshigs bcad de lan gsum brjod pa yin la/ rten med na bskyed chog mi dgos pas/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs po tā la nas zhes sogs spyan 'dren la btsan 'jus byas la mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs nas bzhugs pa la/

de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyang rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i rnam par spyan 'dren bstim sogs 'og nas 'byung ba ltar byed pa yin la/ rten bskyed chog byas nas ye shes spyan drangs pa yin na bstims pa'i gsal kha chos rjes ma gsungs kyang rje btsun gyis gsungs pas/ des na/ gong gi tshigs bcad lan gsum brjod mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ mdun gyi rje btsun ma la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / bsdu rgya sogs gong bzhin byas la/ chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing / /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drangs par bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ /chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi zad nus par ldan/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi dag lha/ /thub pa skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod pas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par bstsal du gsol/ /gyi bar du brjod pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs la/ khyed kyi rang bzhin yang dag pas/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba mi mnga' yang / /bdag cag sgrib pa sbyangs slad du/ /gtsang ma chab kyis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ gis khrus gsol/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha na ye swāhās sku phyis/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul/

/gos bzang srab la 'jam mdzes sna tshogs dang / /rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag 'bul/ /oṃ badzra wasatra ā laṃ ka ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ gis gos rgyan dang / bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ badzra ā sa na pū dza sogs brjod/ me tog gtor la rje btsun ma la thim pas de nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor mos la/ glog dang 'dra ba'i spyan mnga' ma/ /dpa' mo tā re tuttā re/ /sangs rgyas zhal gyi padma yi/ /ge sar las byung khyod la 'dud/ /ston ka'i zla ba rgyas pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs zhal mnga' ma/ /mchog sbyin phyag rgya utpal la/ /bsnams ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i gzeb las tuttā re/ /swā hās nyon mongs zhi bar mdzad/ /oṃ gyi ngo bo nyid kyis ni/ /tshangs pa'i sgo 'byed khyod la 'dud/ /'jigs pa chen po brgyad las ni/ /'jig rten thams cad skyobs par mdzad/ /kun gyi ma ru gyur pa yi/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha dang lha min cod pan gyis/ /zhabs kyi pad mo la btud de/ /phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas phyag byas te/ stan la 'dug la/ chos rjes gong gi mchod pa byin rlabs gcig po des 'thus par mdzad nas/ mchod pa 'og ma rnams la byin rlabs ma gsungs kyang / spro na 'og nas 'byung ba'i mchod pa so so'i mgor byin rlabs byas kyang chog 'on kyang dharmā ra ṇi dang rol chen mi dgos/ gong ltar mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ dri med gtsang zhing yan lag brgyad ldan chu/ /thang skyes chu skyes chu chen me tog bcas/ /dri zhim yid 'ong ldan pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la mchod pa 'bul/ /gu ru tā re badzra arghaṃ pu dza aḥhūm̐/

dus gsum rgyal ba'i dbu la mchod 'bul ma/ /puṣpe dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /thang skyes chu skyes me tog dkon mang bsnams/ /rgyal ba skyed༞ /puṣpe༞ dus gsum rgyal ba'i shangs la mchod 'bul ma/ /spos ma dud kha zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /lhan skyes sbyar dang yongs gyur spos khang bsnams/ /rgyal ba skyed༞ /dhūpaṃ༞ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan la mchod 'bul ma/ /dī paṃ dmar skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /nyi zla rin chen snang gsal sna tshogs bsnams/ /rgyal ba skyed༞ /ā lo ke༞ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs la mchod 'bul ma/ /dri ma ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /a kar tsandan ga pur dung chos bsnams/ /rgyal ba skyed༞ /gandhe༞ dus gsum rgyal ba'i ljags la mchod 'bul ma/ /ro ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /ro dang bcud ldan lha rdzas zhal zas bsnams/ /rgyal ba skyed༞ /nai widya༞ dus gsum rgyal ba'i snyan la mchod 'bul ma/ /sgrol ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /pi wang gling bu sil snyan sna tshogs bsnams/ /rgyal ba skyed༞ /shapta āḥhūm̐ gis mchod pa dang / spro na maṇḍal rgyas pa so bdun ma'am/ bdun pa gang rung gong bzhin la/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes sogs gong bzhin gyi mthar/ sa gzhi spos byugs sngags bcas/ bsdu na sa gzhi spos byugs sngags bcas kyis chog de nas phan yon dran bzhin pas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ oṃ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nas/ phyag 'tshal ba ni nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar lan gnyis bton la phyag byas nas stan la 'dug go /'di la chos rjes/ oṃ rje btsun ma nas/ 'joms pa tu re rab mchog nyid ma la sogs pa'i bar zhes gsungs pa'i sogs khongs nas de 'phros tshig rkang gnyis po 'di thon rgyu yin/ de nas thal mo sbyar la/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang /

/phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi/ /rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la/ /kun nas dwang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /me tog bdug spos mar me dri/ /zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul nas dbul/ /'phags ma'i tshogs kyis bzhes su gsol/ /thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga/ /sems ni nyon mongs dbang gyur pa'i/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems/ /so so skye bo la sogs kyis/ /dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa/ /bsod nams la ni bdag yi rang / /sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang / /blo yi bye brag ji lta bar/ /che chung thun mong min pa'i chos/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /'khor ba ji srid ma stongs bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' thugs rje yis/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtshor byings ba yi/ /sems can rnams la gzigs su gsol/ /bdag gis bsod nams ci bsags pa/ /thams cad byang chub rgyur gyur nas/ /ring po mi thogs 'gro ba yi/ /'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig /ces yan lag bdun pa bya/ bzlas pa'i skabs su rje btsun gyis mdun gyi rje btsun ma dmigs pa gsal bar byas la zhes dang / chos rjes/ rje btsun ma'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng la dmigs te/ zhes gsungs pas de'i ngag 'don ni/ mdun gyi rje btsun ma'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i tāṃ yig ljang khu'i mthar/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swāhā/ zhes pa g.yas skor langs stabs kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te/ mdun gyi rje btsun ma dang rang la thim zhes dang / yi ge bcu pa sum brgya bgrang / mthar nad zhi ba la/ sarba gra he bhyaḥ gdon la/ sarba duṣṭan/ bgegs la/ sarba bighnan/

rims la/ dzwa re/ nyer 'tshe la/ u pa dra be/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba la/ a kā la mṛ tyu/ ltas ngan pa la/ dur mi ti/ rmi lam ngan pa la/ dur sob ti/ rnam g.yeng la/ tsitta ku le bhyaḥ shintaṃ ku ru swāhā/ kun la sbyar ba'i spel tshig can/ de nas rje btsun ma la rtse gcig tu dmigs pa'i yi ge gnyis kyi sbyor ba bla ma kha che'i lugs tā re sum brgya brjod/ de nas maṇḍal phul la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ zhes gsungs pas/ spro na maṇḍal sa gzhi spos byugs ma sngags bcas phul ba'i mthar/ me tog 'thor bzhin pas/ bsdu na me tog 'thor bzhin pas/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi/ /sgrib gnyis byang nas tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs te/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par mdzad du gsol/ /de ma thob kyi tshe rabs kun tu yang / /lha dang mi yi bde ba mchog thob nas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa bsgrub par byed pa la/ /bar chad gdon bgegs nad dang rims la sogs/ /dus min 'chi bar gyur pa sna tshogs dang / /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan pa dang / /'jigs pa brgyad sogs nye bar 'tshe ba rnams/ /myur du zhi zhing med par mdzad du gsol/ /'jig rten 'jig rten las ni 'das pa yi/ /bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa rnams/ /'phel zhing rgyas pa'i don rnams ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/ /bsgrub la brtson zhing dam chos 'phel ba dang / /rtag tu khyed sgrub zhal mchog mthong ba dang / /stong nyid don rtogs byang sems rin po che/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /ces gsol ba gdab/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ /padma dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du/ /lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /ces pa'i smon lam dang / bdag gis tshe rabs kun tu bsgrubs pa'i lha/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las ma/

/sngo ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis myur zhi dpa'/ /yum gyur utpal bsnams ma'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'i bkra shis dang / me tog gtor/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma khyed la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ zhes sogs kyis kyang gsol ba gdab bo/ /rje btsun ma la mchod pa dang maṇḍal 'bul chog dang po'o/ /gnyis pa man chad rje btsun gyi gsung la chos rjes gsal byed mdzad pa ni/ yang / 'jig rten gsum mgon yum gyur spyan yangs ma/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum/ /gnyis med ye shes ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /thugs rje'i dbang gis 'phrin las sna tshogs mdzad/ /byams pa'i yum gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku mdog ljang khu phrin las sna tshogs mdzad/ /yon tan rab rgyas bcu drug lon pa'i tshul/ /'gro la rab dgyes zhal ni 'dzum pa dang / /zhi ba'i spyan gyis 'jig rten gsum la gzigs/ /thugs rje che mnga' khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang sems rang bzhin zla ba gdan du btings/ /nyon mongs mi bskyod rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas/ /sgrib pa kun spangs padma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /zag med bde rgyas zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ /zag med bde ba che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na bza' mchog dang rin chen du mas spras/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin sgrub la dngos grub ster/ /g.yon pa utpal skyon bral dag pa'i rtags/ /phyag gnyis thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel/ /mtha' bral zung 'jug sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas phyag 'tshal/ gzhan sngar bzhin las bstod pa tshar gsum 'don no/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mchod pa/ maṇḍal gnyis sngar bzhin dang / phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar gsum/ yan lag bdun pa bcas bzlas pa dang 'dod gsol rnams kyang sngar bzhin no/ /maṇḍal 'bul chog gnyis pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ thugs rje chen po sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag stong spyan stong༞ /sman pa'i rgyal po༞ /sman 'dra nad 'joms༞ /thugs rje thabs mkhas༞ /sa ltar brtan gyur༞

/chu ltar bsil mdzad༞ /me ltar smin mdzad༞ /rlung ltar rgyas mdzad sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes rje btsun rin po che dang chos rje gnyis mthun par phyag 'tshal 'di las ma gsungs kyang spyir btang bzhin/ mkha' ltar khyab mdzad sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku yi skyon spangs mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /gsung gi skyon spangs ka la ping ka'i dbyangs/ /thugs kyi skyon spangs shes bya mtha' dag gzigs/ /bkra shis dpal 'bar ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod kyang 'gal ba cher med dam snyam/ de nas mchod pa dang maṇḍal sngar dang 'dra ba las/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar bdun bton pa'i mthar/ lha mo la gus sogs phan yon brjod pa'ang bya/ gong ma rnams la phan yon brjod pa 'di mi dgos/ gong ltar de nas yan lag bdun pa/ sngags bzhi brgya/ yi ge gnyis pa'ang bzhi brgya bzla zhing 'dod gsol bkra shis kyi bar gong bzhin te maṇḍal 'bul chog gsum pa'o/ /de dag gi go don ni/ phan yon brjod pa'i skabs su/ gnyis gsum bdun du mngon par brjod na/ /bu 'dod pas ni bu thob 'gyur zhing / /zhes sogs gsungs pa la brten nas cho ga 'di mdzad pa yin pas maṇḍal gsum la bstod pa'i grangs nges bzung can no/ /de rnams kyi dngos gzhi song nas/ rjes chog la rje btsun rin po ches/ gtor 'bul dang dge ba bsngo ba tsam zhig las ma gsungs kyang de'i gsal byed chos rjes/ rjes la/ gtor ma bsngo ba/ gtang rag gi mchod pa/ dge ba bsngo ba/ lhag chad bskang ba/ bzod pa gsol ba/ gshegs su gsol ba/ shis pa brjod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gtor ma bzhi bshams pa/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā wa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las rin po che'i snod du oṃ aḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi zhal zas su bskyed pa'i dang po/ na maḥsarba bhuddha bo dhi satwa nāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta sha sa na nāṃ/ he he bha ga wa te ma hā satwa sarba buddha ā ba lo ki te mā bi laṃ ba ma bi laṃ ba i daṃ ba liṃ ghṛhṇa pa ya ghṛhṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ dza dzaḥsarba bi pan tsa re swāhā/

zhes gsum mam lngas rje btsun ma la 'bul/ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ lha dang lha min cod pan zhes sogs kyis bstod/ sngar bzhin gsol ba gdab bo/ /gtor ma gnyis pa/ a kā ro'i sngags kyis chos skyong spyi la phul la/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes zhes sogs kyi rjes su/ bde blag tu 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod ces brjod do/ /gtor ma gsum pa'i skabs su/ chos rjes de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan sngon dang / sngags rjes la gsungs pas/ sdom gsum rab dbye'i dgag bya der song 'dra yang / chos rje'i dgongs pa ci yin ma shes/ rang gi go tshod la sngags sngon dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brjod rjes la byas nas sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste zhes sogs chos sbyin byas pa la 'gal ba ci yang med dam snyam/ gang ltar kyang de'i rjes su/ gtor ma 'di'i 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga skye ba rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la zas skom bdud rtsi'i char chen po babs/ zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas/ myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangs thob par gyur cig ces smon lam gdab bo/ /bzhi pa a kā ros gzhi bdag la bsngos/ chos kyi sbyin pa byin la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bstan pa dar ba sogs kyi rjes su stong grogs mdzod/ ces brjod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ bla ma dkon mchog gi bstod pa bsdus pa'i rjes su/ ji snyed su dag gi yan lag bdun pa sngar bzhin bya'o/ /'dir yang mchod pa de yan lag bdun pa'i khongs su song ba bsdus pa'i lugs so/ /gsum pa ni/ dgongs gsol sngar bzhin las/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa thob nas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgyal mtsho chen po myur du skem par gyur cig

sems can ma brgal ba rnams sgrol ba'i mthu thogs pa med pa dang ldan par gyur cig ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar byed pa'i༞ sems can mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams mya ngan 'das pa'i༞ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhi mtha' dag la slob cing / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che byed pa la mthu thogs pa med pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces brjod do/ /bzhi pa ni/ yi ge brgya pa 'don pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /zhes sogs kyi rjes su/ bdag cag so so'i skye bo/ bsam pa nyon mongs pa can du gyur pa'i dbang gis/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing bying rgod kyi dbang du gyur pa dang / yo byad la dbang ma thob pas/ mchod pa'i dngos po chung zhing ngan pa/ gtsang sbras ma byed pa/ cho ga bzhin du ma lcogs pa la sogs pa nongs pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams la bzod par gsol lo/ /bdag cag la 'phral dang yun du sgrib par mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod do/ /drug pa ni/ oṃ khyed kyis nas muḥ'i bar brjod la/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang / po tā lar gshegs par bsgoms pa'am/ mdun gyi rten yod na/ de dag la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bdun pa ni/ ston mchog dam pa'i bkra shis brjod pa ste/ sgrol ma maṇḍal bzhi'i cho ga'i rim pa phyag len ltar bkod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas gong du tshogs zhing shin tu mang bas/ rten med pa la gshegs gsol yang thob la/ gtsug lag khang lta bu na mchog gsum gyi rten mang du yod pas brtan bzhugs kyang thob cing / yang sgrub pa po bya bral lta bu rten ye med pa rnams kyis gshegs gsol kho na bya'o/ /gang ltar kyang brtan bzhugs la/ phyogs bcu na sogs spyi 'gre bzhin rgyas pa brjod pa'am/ bdag dang 'gro la sogs shlau ka gcig gi mthar/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/

zhes bsdus pa byas kyang chog brtan bzhugs kyi rjes su/ chos rjes bkra shis las ma gsungs kyang / bsngo smon bsdus tsam bgyis pa la gong du rgyas pa song ba dang 'gal ba med pas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'phags ma sgrol ma sogs/ 'phags ma sgrol ma khyed sku sogs༞ khyed la mchod cing sogs༞ sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig sogs༞ sems can 'di dag sogs༞ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun sogs༞ bsod nams 'di yis sogs༞ sangs rgyas sku gsum sogs༞ byas la bkra shis bya'o/ /'dis ni maṇḍal mchod chog rgyas bsdus gnyis thon pa yod la/ 'bring po ni chos rje bla ma'i gsung bzhin dang / shin tu bsdu na rmor chen rje'i yig cha bzhin no/ /zhes rje btsun sgrol ma'i bstod sgrub maṇḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga 'di yang / sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi gsung rab kyi dgongs don sor bzhag la de dag tu mi gsal ba/ don la thob thang gang yod kha bskangs te rang bzos ma bslad par go bder sbyar ba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ sgrol ma maṇḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
